We have a large surplus of renewable energy,
which lets us experiment with new ways to power our society.
It takes big changes and lots of collaboration,
but we're working toward completely replacing fossil fuels.

Education used to be about bulding a strong foundation -

Our green energy brings new people and new ideas to Skellefteå.
We need to make space for them. How do we create housing fast...
and what happens to our society if the need suddenly drops?

Behold, the 2030 Strategy!

We brought all the voices from the Citizen Dialogue together to create Skellefteå's "2030
Strategy." Not a very catchy title, but an important document! Here, we describe our vision
for the future: We want to become a great and sustainable place to live. Easy to say, but
things get complicated very quickly!

Can we be
climate neutral by 2040?
Possibly, yes!

Can we develop energy for
lifelong creativity?

Can we make our society better
for people and nature?

Boliden is a global company that's deeply grounded
 in our community – about 2 kilometersdeep, to
 be precise. To compete on the world stage,
 they constantly explore new sites, newways of doing
 things, even new materials. Here are 6 moments
 where wild thinking helpedthe company succeed. Do you
 ever worry that it can't be done here?
 That big things aredone in big cities by
 people with big money? Can you know what's
 possible before you try?
Can you see stories in the stones?

Do you worry about the future?
Growing our town is an opportunity to do things differently, in ways that are better for people
and nature. What are your worries? What do you dream about? Do you dare to put your
thoughts on the wall?

Welcome to a story of energy from nature to now
Wild, messy dreams in progress
Everything was dreamed up at some point, what's next?

How do you
see the future?

Behold, the 2030 Strategy!

We brought all the voices from the Citizen Dialogue together to create Skellefteå's "2030
Strategy." Not a very catchy title, but an important document! Here, we describe our vision
for the future: We want to become a great and sustainable place to live. Easy to say, but
things get complicated very quickly!

What if we want to be more connected to nature, to each other, to ourselves?

This is a lung. This is a tree. We breathe in what trees breathe out, and they breathe in what
we breathe out. We are nature. But what would it look like to live closer to nature? What
changes would we need to make? Could it actually work… and how???

How big is your vision and how tall can you go?
Build your elevator tower and see if your ideas hold up!

How do you show people who you are?
We've always known that Skellefteå is a creative place, and that we're curious about new
ideas. But that's not exactly how the rest of Sweden saw us! When we decided to grow, we
also developed a new logo and tagline for our town… maybe you've seen it? Did this logo
actually help develop our identity and increase pride in our town? Is that magic? Or
marketing?
